# The Studio of Worlds

> AI cinematic studio that builds original universes, reimagines myths and legends, and adapts classic literature using AI-driven filmmaking (character/species introductions, teasers, and shorts).

Creative partners: PixVerse, ThankYou AI, YouArt AI.

## Original Universes
- Quantum Racers — high-velocity rivalries in a neon-drenched racing league
- Lunar Force Omega — an elite squadron faces the tyrant Magmatron
- The Mass Stellar — species and secrets collide across a fractured galaxy
- Behemoths — living, breathing prehistoric giants
- Electropolis — a city of livewire superheroes led by Lightning Lass (coming soon)
- Chronicles of Pteros — Aesir the Fallen returns home
- The Other Bonaparte — a reimagined empire told through its unlikely court
- Devil's Bend — Elijah Coltrane and Blue ride into legend
- Tiwanaku — Wayra and Titi guard the memory of a lost Andean empire

## Myths & Legends
- Hercules: Son of Zeus (Greek myth)
- The Odyssey (Greek myth)
- The Morrigan, Manannán mac Lir, Clíodhna, Nuada Airgetlám, Áine, Brigid, The Fomorian Horde, King Balor (Irish myth / Tuatha)

## Timeless Classics (literary adaptations)
- Oz (L. Frank Baum)
- A Tale of Two Cities (Charles Dickens)
- A Christmas Carol (Charles Dickens) — coming soon
- Kidnapped (Robert Louis Stevenson)
- The Secret Garden (Frances Hodgson Burnett)
- Pan Tadeusz (Adam Mickiewicz)
- The Black Arrow (Robert Louis Stevenson)
